sam: CI microbench failed on PR #16890 — prefetch path microbench shows tail-latency +13% vs main.

anya: @sam saw the alert. Can you paste the failing numbers? :eyes:

sam: paste:
```
Benchmark: microbench/prefetch_kv_path
Main median p95: 42.1ms
PR median p95: 47.5ms
Threshold: 45.0ms
Delta: +13.3% (p95)
```

lee: ack. Was this run on the GPU autotune runner or shadow infra?

sam: CI job: gpu-autotune/cpu-shadow-12
Logs: https://ci.redwood/16890/bench

margot: I ran a local bisect with the perf harness, looks like regression introduced between commits abc1234 -> def5678. Commit def5678 changed kernel selector fallback logic.

anya: Any quick repro? Would reverting def5678 make the perf green? :thinking:

margot: quick repro attached. Local perf shows +11% p95 with def5678 vs abc1234 on the same harness.

sam: we need a hotfix. This is blocking the rollout (canary scheduled). Suggest revert + run CI. @dev-bot can you open a revert PR?

dev-bot: opened revert PR #16902 reverting def5678 — https://git.redwood/revert/16902 :recycle:

lee: pinging kernel-owner @orn and runtime @jay for review — we should also run the KV cache warmup profile to ensure no hidden hit-rate drop.

orn: looking. I'll run kvcache warmup profile on the PR shortly.

jay: adding profiling traces now. One suspicious trace: increased prep time in kernel_autoselect() when sequence length < 128.

sam: attaching snippet from trace:
```
[trace] kernel_autoselect() total=12.4ms -> 18.9ms
[call] select_kernel_by_seqlen() 0.9ms -> 6.0ms
```

anya: If select_kernel_by_seqlen path is expensive, maybe we hit a new O(N) loop introduced by def5678. Can we optimize to cache decisions per model/config?

margot: good idea. Short-term revert to unblock rollout. Longer fix: memoize kernel choice keyed by (model, seqlen_bucket, quant_profile).

lee: agreed. Revert merged -> CI triggered. sam: pls monitor canary after rollout resumes.

sam: thanks. CI is running on revert PR now: https://ci.redwood/revert/16902/status

dev-bot: CI on revert PR passed microbench stage ✅

sam: rolling canary now. will report back in 30m.

anya: great job quick bisect + revert. Follow-up issue for memoization + unit test to catch select_kernel perf please.

margot: filed issue #2382 with repro and perf sample.

sam: closing thread once canary stable. :thumbsup:
